title: Debouncer coalesces calls but never exceeds max-wait
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might think timer cancellation races the flush. The pending function is swapped out under the lock before any callback runs, so a stale timer firing after cancel or flush finds nothing pending and does nothing.
